correctness.rationale: An equality graph connects each initial index i<k to all translated positions i+n_j; independent q-letter assignments constant on each of c components give probability q^{c−V}=q^{-tk+β}. Two translates give forests, hence pairwise independence. For three shifts, subtract n1, write gaps a,b and project overlap edges onto initial indices, lengths a,b; contracting a-residue chains and selecting b-edges yields c=max(gcd(a,b), a+b−k) for k>max(a,b), and β=0 below the sharp threshold. Thus β=max(0,k−a−b+g) and the centered third moment is q^{-3k}(q^β−1). Independent union-find checker covered 2704 gap/length triple cases and corresponding pair cases; finite tests do not prove all k/gaps, which rest on the explicit component proof.
